Copies of the components' example configurations (2026-11-26), read by
`tests/schemas.rs`:

- `niruwm-config.example.toml`: niruwm `config.example.toml` (NIRUWM 0.37.15)
- `nirux-config.example.toml`: nirux `config.example.toml`, the file NIRUX installs
- `nirulock-config.example.toml`: nirulock `config.example.toml` (NIRULOCK 0.30.0)
- `niruscreensaver-config.example.toml`: NIRUSCREENSAVER 0.18.0
- `nirux-sounds.example.toml`, `nirux-appearance.example.toml`: nirux 0.12.373

When the component repositories are checked out next to this one
(`../niruwm`, `../nirubar`, ...), the test also reads their current files.
